title: Brown's work continues in black aerospace subcompartments

tellings.quote: But in deep black American aerospace, I believe Brown's work still exists in the form of whispers and vital subcompartments where it gets explored further.

plain: The work of Thomas Townsend Brown, a researcher whose high-voltage experiments Michels ties to antigravity, is said to live on inside secret US aerospace programmes, in small sealed-off compartments where only a few people are cleared to explore it further. Michels offers this as his own belief, saying it survives "in the form of whispers," and names no source.
